# DIORAMA

> A static browser-based 3D mechanical puzzle game with 25 levels and a 60-second ending. GitHub main is the development source. This index points to current documentation; it does not certify indexing by AI/search services.

## Current documentation

- [AI entry instructions](AGENTS.md): read first for repository work.
- [Current AI handoff](AI_HANDOFF_DIORAMA.md): architecture, protected decisions, current ending mix, publications and open verification.
- [Release state](docs/RELEASE_STATE.json): dated runtime commit, asset hashes, Sites identity, itch.io package evidence and limitations.
- [README](README.md): project overview and developer architecture.
- [Ending contract](ENDING_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md): current audio/readiness/dust/replay/CTA behavior.
- [File inventory](docs/FILE_INVENTORY.md): active, historical, asset and tooling roles.
- [Latest audit](docs/RECONCILIATION_AUDIT_2026-11-07.md): reconciliation evidence.
- [Release procedure](docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md): separate Vercel, Sites and itch.io publishing steps.
- [Level authoring](docs/LEVEL_AUTHORING.md): existing embedded level schema and validation limits.
